info.name: Astronomy API - Location Based Astronomy Data Other APIs API
Returns sunrise, sunset, moon phase, and celestial positions for a given location and date.

params.name: format
params.description: Format of the response. Can be "json" or "xml".

params.name: location
params.description: Extract astronomy information using location (preferably city)

params.name: lat
params.description: Latitude to extract astronomy information using location coordinates

params.name: long
params.description: Longitude to extract astronomy information using location coordinates

params.name: ip
params.description: IPv4 or IPv6 address to extract astronomy information using IP address

params.name: lang
params.description: Response language of "location" field in case of lookup through IP address only.

params.name: date
params.description: Specific date (format YYYY-MM-DD) for which astronomy data is required

params.name: elevation
params.description: Elevation above sea level at the location, in meters. The value should be between 0 meter and a maximum value of 10,000 meters. Negative value is set to 0.

params.name: time_zone
params.description: Time zone to receive all time-based data in your preferred local time.

items.docs: Retrieve sunrise and sunset times, current position of the moon, and other related information by specifying a location address, location coordinates, IP address, or using the client IP address if no parameter is passed.
